Package com.github.crittscott.somestacks.client.measure

Class AutoRenderProfiles

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.client.measure.AutoRenderProfiles
public final class AutoRenderProfiles extends Object
Per-item cache of measured render profiles, persisted client-side so each item is normally measured only once across sessions.

Measurements describe baked models and are invalidated with them:

  • A measurement-format change rejects the previous algorithm's entries.
  • A mod-version change drops entries from that mod's namespace.
  • A manual resource reload drops the entire cache.
  • A different resource-pack selection between sessions rejects the persisted cache.
The initial resource reload must preserve the persisted cache long enough to compare its recorded mod versions and resource-pack list with the current client.
